propositions: Operators using OpenAI-compatible gateways cannot attribute LLM calls to rebar or correlate them with gate runs and verdicts because rebar sends no request metadata or trace identifiers
The trace_id field is reserved in review_result and completion_verdict schemas but hardcoded to None in llm/runner.py, leaving the correlation capability unimplemented
An operator needs a generic, vendor-neutral mechanism to configure arbitrary request headers with environment variable and per-run value interpolation without editing rebar source code

Header values must be redacted from logs and verdict records to prevent credential leakage, and malicious headers (Authorization, x-api-key, Cookie, Host, Proxy-Authorization, or those with CR/LF/NUL) must be rejected at config resolution

Each LLM call within a single gate run must carry the same correlation identity, and gate runs outside a review or completion scope (such as review-code) must omit headers with missing ${run:...} substituends
